text: One has to do something new in order to see something new.
author: Georg Christoph Lichtenberg
visual_brief: Aerospace engineering schematic in crisp white line work on black of a deployable starshade spacecraft: an intricate geometric ring of serrated petals radiating outward, with fine dashed sightlines projecting past its edges toward a distant telescope focal point, and curved motion arrows indicating the outward unfolding of the petal hinges.
alt: Engineering drawing of a starshade spacecraft unfolding its geometric petals.
